purpose: Phase-8A apoptosis-evasion resistance. Represents an increased EFFECTIVE apoptosis threshold / reduced commitment abstraction / reduced downstream loss pressure as an ordinal state producing a BOUNDED modifier. Bax / Bcl-2 / caspase molecular values are NEVER changed directly, and an apoptosis change is applied at ONE level only (no double counting with the population modifier). Schematic ordinal only.

coefficient_policy.1_interpretation: 1 = maximal schematic increase in effective apoptosis threshold the model represents
coefficient_policy.source: general apoptosis-evasion resistance biology applied predictively
coefficient_policy.sensitivity_note: consumed by resistanceToApoptosisAdapter once; the double-counting guard prevents re-application through the population-loss modifier.
coefficient_policy.limitations: No Bax/Bcl-2/caspase level or commitment probability value (all NOT_REPORTED).

rules.single_application: An apoptosis-evasion effect is applied through the apoptosis adapter only; it is not re-added to the final population-loss modifier.
